test_title: PYST 32: SSC CGL 2022 - English (Held On: 09 Dec 2022 Shift 4)
subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

Sunil cannot _________ a trip to the US now because he has already spent a lot for the completion of his house.
solution: The correct answer is option 2), i.e., 'afford.' [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • Let's look at the meaning of the words given in the options: • visit​- to go to a place with a specific purpose. (मिलने जाना) • afford​- to have enough money to pay for something. (भुगतान करने में समर्थ होना) • spend- to use money to pay for something. (खर्च करना) • earn- to receive money in return for work or services. (कमाना) • The context of the sentence is that Sunil cannot make a trip to the US now because he does not have enough money as he has already spent a lot of money on the completion of his house. • According to the above-mentioned points, the most appropriate word to fill in the blank is "afford." • Therefore, the correct answer is Option 2. • Another example: • *I cannot **afford** to buy a new car this year.* Complete Sentence:__ *Sunil cannot __**afford**__ a trip to the US now because he has already spent a lot for the completion of his house.* 30:Tc35c,
